youtube.title: Reverse Engineer Anything with Claude Code: Free REA Setup
youtube.description:
Reverse Engineer Anything (REA) lets Claude Code show how a feature in an app works, with evidence, after one free setup command.
Free guide (setup + 3 prompts): https://withhammad.com/resources/reverse-engineer-features-with-claude-code

Setup: run npx rea-agents setup, choose Claude Code, approve, restart.
It inspects desktop and Electron apps, websites and Android APKs on your own machine. No iOS target is listed.
It shows the evidence for each step and lists what it could not confirm.
Only use it on software you own or are authorized to examine.

Checked 14 Nov 2026: MIT licence, npm rea-agents 6.9.0, Node.js 22.23.4+, 24.22.1+ or 26.12.1+.
Source: https://github.com/morluto/rea

Get the setup steps and my 3 prompts: https://withhammad.com/resources/reverse-engineer-features-with-claude-code
Subscribe for more AI builds: https://www.youtube.com/@with.hammad?sub_confirmation=1
